facts.text: The hotel sits on the Left Bank, between the Seine and Boulevard Saint-Germain.
facts.excerpt: between the Seine and Boulevard Saint-Germain

facts.text: The hotel is steps away from the literary cafes and art galleries of Saint-Germain-des-Prés.
facts.excerpt: steps away from the literary cafés and art galleries that shaped the legend of the neighbourhood

facts.text: The neighbourhood around the hotel is the Paris that inspired Hemingway, Sartre and Simone de Beauvoir.
facts.excerpt: the Paris that inspired Hemingway, Sartre and Simone de Beauvoir

facts.text: The hotel is wrapped in warm wood tones with an intimate atmosphere.
facts.excerpt: Wrapped in warm wood tones and an intimate atmosphere

facts.text: The rooms and suites are light-filled.
Rooms look out over Parisian rooftops, with Haussmann rooftops and monuments in sight.
facts.excerpt: From your room with Parisian rooftop views

facts.text: Depending on their location and orientation, certain room categories offer a view of the Eiffel Tower.
facts.excerpt: Depending on their location and orientation, certain room categories offer a view of the Eiffel Tower.

facts.text: The hotel's flagship family accommodation is the 2-Bedroom Panoramic Terrace Suite, designed for up to 5 guests.
facts.excerpt: flagship family accommodation is the 2-Bedroom Panoramic Terrace Suite

facts.text: Each Junior Suite has a living area with a sofa bed for two children under the age of 12.
facts.excerpt: Each suite features a dedicated living area equipped with a sofa bed, carefully selected to provide a restful night

facts.text: Breakfast is served overlooking the hotel's Japanese garden.
The hotel offers its guests direct access to L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon.
facts.excerpt: offers its guests a direct access to L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon

facts.text: Bar F-Sharp hosts live jazz every Monday, Thursday and Saturday evening.
facts.excerpt: Every Monday, Thursday and Saturday evening, let yourself be captivated by intimate live performances

facts.text: Every month the hotel's lounges host literary dinners, orchestrated by journalist and writer Olivier Barrot, bringing together an author and guests around a gastronomic dinner.
facts.excerpt: Orchestrated by journalist and writer Olivier Barrot, these evenings bring together an author and their guests around a gastronomic dinner

facts.text: Until 4 January 2027 the hotel hosts the exhibition Collection Parisienne by Aurélie Clérault.
facts.excerpt: hosts until 4 January 2027 the exhibition Collection Parisienne by Aurélie Clérault

facts.text: Hotel staff will make reservations at L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon on guests' behalf; booking in advance is recommended.
facts.excerpt: Our staff will be glad to make the reservation on your behalf

facts.text: The hotel regularly offers special rates for stays of more than 3 nights.
facts.excerpt: regularly offers special rates for stays of more than 3 nights

facts.text: Saint-Germain-des-Prés keeps a quiet, residential atmosphere while offering convenient access to the capital's major cultural attractions.
facts.excerpt: retaining a quiet, residential atmosphere that is hard to find in the more touristy areas
